      7Pradnyesh

      The only manager to back Tavernier, and he returned 16 with the armband. That is a captain's call with real nerve, and it paid.

      Quietly beat the average on a rough week for the league. Starting A.Becker alone paid off. Unfussy, and only 4 points behind Kalash.

      Decision of the week
      Atharva Kshirsagar picked the wrong 11, and 36 points watched from the bench. Picking the right team keeps being the one job he cannot get right.

      How long can Aditya Dalal stay hot?

      The Streak Wobbles

      Aditya Dalal has been above the league average for 10 weeks in a row, with 112 points in GW2 and 37 in GW11. His GW11 score is the lowest of the whole run, so the streak is now under real pressure.

      1. GW782 pts
      2. GW855 pts
      3. GW960 pts
      4. GW1061 pts
      5. GW1137 pts

      If the points stay low, the run could end and the streak could be settled.

      BuildingGW11You're in this
      +36 on the bench this week

      Will Atharva Kshirsagar ever pick the right 11?

      Bench Blunders Pile Up

      Atharva Kshirsagar has left 216 points on the bench this season, while the league average is 89. The bench keeps costing him, and the season-long question of picking the right 11 is still open.

      If the bench keeps costing points, the curse could become the league's talking point.

      Heating upGW11You're in this
      7th → 4th

      How high can Aryamann go?

      Aryamann Keeps Climbing

      Aryamann started GW2 in 20th place and now sits 4th out of 24, climbing 16 places since. The rise has been steady, with 8th in GW8, 7th in GW10 and 4th in GW11.

      If the climb continues, a place in the top 3 could be within reach.

      Heating upGW11You're in this

      Can Aditya Dharap catch Atharva Kshirsagar?

      The Gap Shrinks to One

      Aditya Dharap has cut Atharva Kshirsagar's lead from 44 in GW8 to just 1 in GW11. Atharva is still ahead, but the gap has been shrinking every week.

      1. GW8Atharva +44
      2. GW9Atharva +43
      3. GW10Atharva +11
      4. GW11Atharva +1

      If Aditya Dharap gets past Atharva, the chase could flip in a single gameweek.

      Who can hold the crown?

      Sukrut Pulls Clear

      Sukrut leads on 742 points, 24 ahead of Aditya Dalal on 718, and that gap has grown from 18. Sukrut has now been top for 3 weeks in a row, and the lead has changed hands 5 times this season.

      Sukrut742top
      Aditya Dalal718−24
      Prerana715−27
      Aryamann690−52

      If Aditya Dalal, who led in GW7 and GW8, can win points back, the crown could be contested again.

      How it's worked out

      Each manager gets a 0-100 score from three things, across every gameweek this season (11 so far): how many of the league picked the same captain (45%), how many of their 11 are in most other teams (45%), and points spent on hits (10%). The fewer people you copy, the more daring you are. 50 is your league's average manager. Ghosts (no transfers or chips in 3+ gameweeks) aren't rated.
